title: Assertion: AXI-Lite Write Protocol Monitor
constraints: Rules 1–3: `awvalid`, `wvalid` and `bvalid` each stay high until their handshake (valid && ready) completes.
Rule 4: `bvalid` may only be asserted after **both** an address handshake and a data handshake happened (in earlier cycles) that haven't been answered by a response yet.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Rules 1–3 are three copies of `x_valid && !x_ready |=> x_valid`.
Rule 4 needs bookkeeping: count completed AW and W handshakes, subtract completed B handshakes, and assert `bvalid |-> aw_pending > 0 && w_pending > 0` using the counters from before the edge.
Handshakes in the same cycle as `bvalid` don't count yet: the response must come later.

examples.title: early B
examples.input: bvalid after AW but before W
